dormancy: No flow here declares an `on()` trigger, no schedule is registered, nothing is deployed, and nothing references this directory from a drive loop or CI job. The suite runs only when a human or the Garden invokes `flows run` explicitly.
adoptWhen: flows run in cloud and the gates listed per pair have closed; the Garden should then run each red case (expect pass) and each green case (expect fail) as the standing proof the bug is still open, and flip the pair to green-only once the fix lands.

typecheck.note: Not part of `npm test`. Types come from regressions/surface.d.ts, a declaration-only slice of the v2 surface; delete it once @relayflows/surface exists.

surfaceGaps.need: A red case must assert that an operation fails in a declared way. The surface has no `expect(kind)` form, so every red probe is a deterministic step that always exits 0 and prints the observed status/body for a postfix gate to judge.
No browser helper, so `the UI shows this string` is not assertable. The cross-account pair asserts the API-level cause instead: the response body carries no code the client could branch on.
gate 7's sandbox router has no macOS pool; the bun-compiled argv bug does not reproduce under node or `bun run`.

Two or three credential principals inside one run (CLI bearer, browser session, in-account non-owner). Expressed as `principals/<name>` mount paths and an `as:` argument; gate 8 must make that real and non-ambient.

The relaycast gateway's internal maintenance API is guarded by a shared service bearer, not a user session. It still has to resolve from `<mount>/principals/<name>/token` like every other credential (gate 8), and the workspace key being re-registered must be read inline from the cloud mount so no secret enters the flow source or the journal. Needs a relayfile adapter for the relaycast gateway (gate 6) exposing base_url, principals/cloud-control-plane, and relay-workspaces/<id>/relaycast_api_key.

A red case cannot force a downstream dependency to fail, so a defect that only shows when a dependency errors (here: an unguarded D1 write that turns any database fault into an untyped 500) is observable only while a real fault window happens to be open. Without injection the green case can pass against healthy production while the defective code is still deployed — a false green the suite must not mistake for a fix.
